finding: The unreadable check moves a mode 000 reintro-stage.txt aside for uid 1000. Root bypasses it: root can read mode 000 on Linux, so the check does not fire and the stage check repairs the content instead. A readable file is read as-is. Pure. Heat is zero.
mitigation: None needed. The check holds for non-root. Root bypasses it because root can read anything on Linux.
